command_applicability.command_recommendation: After explicit approval, use the dedicated active-session runner for one App 0x06/0x3B request with the approved privilege byte, then validate and close/restore.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Exercise one session-scoped positive or negative privilege transition against an approved ceiling and terminate the context immediately.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a standard candidate, authorization oracle and bounded cleanup to an undefined source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Reading current privilege alone cannot prove enforcement of an allowed or denied transition.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Changing the wrong/shared session can create real elevated access even without persistent configuration.

project_override_considerations: A high-level client is equivalent only if it proves the same already-active session changed privilege and exposes completion/resulting state; opening a new privileged session is not equivalent.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master procedure and criteria are absent/TBD rather than conflicting.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The session-scoped operation is identifiable. Exact session, matrix, runner and cleanup are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Creates an authorization-enforcement test that cannot silently escalate, act on the wrong session or treat a new login as equivalent.
independent_technical_reasoning: Privilege is a property of a specific active session and must be bounded by both account and channel limits. A successful command on a newly created or shared session would not prove the intended transition and could expose capabilities, so session identity, ceiling enforcement, harmless verification and immediate closure are inseparable evidence.
